user.title: Connect Wyze Tunnel
user.description: In Wyze Tunnel, open the gear menu, then Connect apps, then Home Assistant. Make a setup code and paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Wyze Tunnel
reauth_confirm.description: This connection's key was removed in Wyze Tunnel. Make a new setup code on its Connect apps page and paste it here.

error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a setup code. Copy the whole thing, starting with wt1.
error.invalid_auth: Wyze Tunnel didn't accept this code. Make a new one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant can't reach Wyze Tunnel at the address in the code. Check the address on the Connect apps page.

abort.already_configured: This Wyze Tunnel is already set up.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send any Wyze Tunnel camera command, like night_vision on or rotary_action left.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command name, like spotlight, alarm or night_vision.

value.name: Value
value.description: What to set it to, like on or off. Leave empty to read the current value.
